text: Last night a courier in Helena, Montana, carried this to a records archive. We read it. Then we let it go on. If it had not arrived, he would know.
style: SAFETYNET's director. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, deliberate, unhurried. Tonight he can finally prove what he has suspected for months, and he will not say the name until he can; under the control is grief for two agents he sent.
